title: Coalesced Matrix-Free Geometric Multigrid on Persistent Cell-Wise Storage
summary: We present a geometric multigrid preconditioner for high-order continuous finite elements that operates entirely on redundant, cell-wise stored vectors: the assembled global vector is never formed on any level of the hierarchy. In this storage paradigm the machinery that classically complicates adaptive multigrid dissolves. Hanging-node constraints are never assembled: we prove that the plain tensor-product transfer operators, applied to the \emph{unassembled} residual, algebraically reproduce the classical constrained restriction, including the action of the transposed constraint matrix,…
